narrative.overview:
The system draws on Brazilian concrete poetry and the Ruptura and Alexandre Wollner identity programs. The career is set as a concrete poem on a strict square grid. Flat silkscreen planes of paper, ink, cobalt and cadmium yellow meet at hard edges. Type is Jost, a Futura-lineage geometric sans. Display and navigation are lowercase; facts stay in sentence case. The visitor's question is the largest type on the page, and the answer recomposes the page around it.

Density is poster-like at the top and archival further down. The first viewport splits into a paper identity column (5/12) and a full-height cobalt question plane (7/12), with a yellow square straddling the seam. Below it, a year ruler lays roles out as bars of square cells, full-width project planes alternate ink and yellow, and a cobalt close ends the page. Nothing is rounded, nothing casts a shadow, nothing glows or blurs, and there are no gradients.

The yellow square is the system's only mark for "lit / current / active". When the chatbot answers, the page re-lights: matching nav items fill yellow, a matching role's date cell becomes a yellow plane, its ruler bar turns yellow, and a matching project plane gains a module-scale square. Motion moves in whole grid steps and never glides.

Scope: Concreto is the system. The landing route sets `html[data-world="concreto"]`. The `/project/<slug>` case-study routes still render in the previous world (`data-world="lab"`) and are pending migration to Concreto. The stylesheet keeps that world's tokens only so those routes keep working. They are legacy and are not a second system.
keyCharacteristics: Four flat inks (paper, ink, cobalt, signal yellow) plus cobalt support tints for text and rules on the cobalt plane.
Zero radius, zero shadow, 2px ink rules as the only structure.
Jost everywhere, with lowercase display and heavy negative tracking.
The yellow square as the single lit/current/active signal.
Stepped motion in whole grid steps, with a reduced-motion fallback.
Square modules: send button, icon buttons, ruler cells, bullets, source numbers, lit markers.

rules.name: The Lit Square Rule
rules.body: Signal yellow means lit, current, or active, and nothing else. If an element is yellow, it is being answered about, is happening now, or is under the pointer or focus. Yellow as decoration is a bug. The one standing exception is the full-width yellow project plane, which is part of the plane alternation.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Rule
rules.body: Colors are laid down as flat planes with hard edges. Never use gradients, blends, transparency washes, or tints of an ink standing in for a surface.

rules.name: The Plane Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every plane sets its own focus color. Cobalt outlines on paper, yellow outlines on cobalt and ink, and ink outlines on yellow, all 3px with a 3px offset.

rules.name: The Question Is Largest Rule
rules.body: The question field and the asked question are the biggest type on the landing, bigger than the name. If anything outranks them, the hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: Display, nav, buttons and section titles are lowercase (enforced with a lowercase transform over sentence-case source copy). Names of facts inside body text keep their real case.

rules.name: The Whole Step Rule
rules.body: Motion moves in whole grid steps. Ruler bars draw in with an 8-step stepped easing (0.64s, staggered 0.12s). The typing indicator lights three squares in sequence with `steps(1)`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, bars appear drawn and one square stays lit. Scroll is not smoothed in this world.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. If a surface needs separation, give it a different plane color or a 2px rule, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Square Module Rule
rules.body: New marks, bullets, and indicators are squares. There are no circles, pills or dots.

dos: Do reserve signal yellow for lit, current, or active states and the alternating yellow project plane.
Do keep every corner at 0px and every structural line at 2px.
Do set display, nav and button labels lowercase in Jost, with -0.02em to -0.035em tracking at display sizes.
Do keep the question field and asked question the largest type on the landing.
Do express lit state by filling a whole cell or plane with yellow, never by tinting it.
Do move in whole grid steps (stepped easing) and give every animation a reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep the ruler module square: month cells on wide rulers, quarter cells at 700px and below.
Do switch focus outline color per plane (cobalt on paper, yellow on cobalt and ink, ink on yellow).
donts: Don't use shadows, blur, glow, or gradients on any surface.
Don't round corners or introduce circles, pills or dots where a square module fits.
Don't use yellow for decoration or emphasis that is not a lit, current, or active state.
Don't use smooth or eased glides. Motion lands in whole steps.
Don't bring the previous world's dark surfaces, green accent, or Syne/Satoshi/JetBrains Mono faces into Concreto surfaces. They survive only for the unmigrated project routes.
